hook_text: One supermarket, sixty people, and only two of them decide where it will be in five years.
clip_script: A supermarket in Mthatha. At the top of the pyramid: the owner and the general manager. Should we open a second branch? Start home deliveries? Big, long, risky: strategic decisions. In the middle: six department managers. Home delivery is approved, so how do we take orders, pack them, budget for the van? Tactical decisions, about a year ahead. On the floor: ten supervisors. Who packs this morning? Which order goes first? What do we do about the broken eggs? Operational decisions, today. Instructions flow down the pyramid. Problems and ideas flow up. Two plus six plus ten managers, forty-two workers, and one business that only works when every level talks to the others.
visual_style: A whiteboard pyramid with three labelled layers, a delivery van idea dropping from the top layer to the bottom, and arrows running down for instructions and up for reports.
mood: Clear and confident, like a guided tour behind the scenes.
pacing: A quick climb up the pyramid, then a steady descent following one idea down through each level.
call_to_action: Watch the full lesson and sort the decisions by level.
